headline: Both My Parents Had Dementia. For Nine Years, MCM Always Came Through.

carousel.title: Both My Parents Had Dementia. For Nine Years, MCM Always Came Through.
Karen W.
before: Two parents with dementia who didn't think they needed help.
Skeptical · Until they met the caregivers
after: Care that scaled across every stage, all the way through.
Watchful eye · Errands and small tasks early on
One-on-one · Support at their assisted living facility
Overnight · Sitters in their last stages

carousel.title: The care started gentle and grew with them.
carousel.text: Early on it was light: "to keep a watchful eye on them and help with small tasks such as going to the grocery store."

carousel.title: It scaled as their parents declined.
carousel.text: "As their health declined, we relied on the caregivers for added support at their assisted living facility.

carousel.title: They were never alone at the end.
carousel.text: "In their last stages of life, we used caregivers to do the overnight shift as sitters...

carousel.title: MCM showed up everywhere they needed.
carousel.text: "We needed overnight sitters, we needed people in the hospital, and MCM always came through."
I would just like to say how wonderful MCM has been for my parents... I highly recommend them for all of your needs for elderly parents.
carousel.by: Karen W. · about nine years with MCM
